statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, whenever minimum_index(nums) returns a result r, the following holds. Let V be the set of all integers i such that 0 <= i < len(nums) - 1, and there exists an integer x that is dominant in nums[0..i] and also dominant in nums[i+1..len(nums)-1]. If V is nonempty, r is the least element of V; if V is empty, r = -1.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). Assume 1 <= n <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000. Also nums has exactly one dominant element, where an integer x is dominant in a finite array or segment a iff 2 * (the number of positions j in a with a[j] = x) > len(a).
